subject: Re: Request: redistribute committed capacity and SOW edit
messages:
From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@novaapps.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Green <matthew.green@novaapps.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T22:03:00Z
Subject: Request: redistribute committed capacity and SOW edit

Hi Sofia,

Quick note from procurement/engineering at NovaApps — we need to shift 30% of our committed GPU capacity from our US-east cluster to a new EU-based deployment we plan to spin up in November. The current exhibit in our Order Form ties the committed units to region-specific SKUs; that will cause double-counting if we spin up EU.

Can Redwood prepare an amendment (change order) that:
- moves 30% of our committed units from us-east SKU to eu-west SKU, pro-rates the fees for the remainder of the quarter, and
- updates Exhibit B (Implementation SOW) to add the EU cutover window and a short rollback plan.

Attached is a short one-page outline of the target allocation and timing (capacity_rebalance_request.pdf). We expect a short redline and a DocuSign-ready amendment. Also want to confirm there won't be an automatic price uplift for cross-region assignment — we prefer a neutral effect aside from the per-region billing fix.

We have a planned EU cluster go-live week of Nov 9 — can you confirm if you can have a draft amendment + redline back by EOD Oct 20? If not, please propose the earliest alternative.

Thanks,
Elaine Turner
Procurement Manager | NovaApps

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@novaapps.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T23:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: redistribute committed capacity and SOW edit

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. Marking this high priority.

Plan I propose:
1) Legal builds a short change order that: reassigns 30% of committed units to eu-west SKU, prorates fees through the quarter, and updates Exhibit B with the EU cutover window + rollback bullet points.
2) Commercial confirms no cross-region uplift applies (CCing Laura).
3) Implementation drafts the one-paragraph SOW edit and timeline (CCing Karthik for implementation lead).

Rishi — can you take the first pass on redlines? We need a DocuSign-ready amendment that NovaApps can sign; deadline requested is EOD 10/20 (they have Nov 9 go-live target). If you need extra detail from NovaApps on the rollback plan, Elaine — can you share a brief rollback acceptance criteria (one bullet list) by tomorrow morning?

I'll line up a 30-minute sync if helpful after the redline is ready.

– Sofia
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@novaapps.com>, Matt Green <matthew.green@novaapps.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: redistribute committed capacity and SOW edit

On Mon, Oct 18, 2026 at 23:15 Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. Marking this high priority.
> 
> Plan I propose: ...

Team — taking lead on redline. Initial notes and asks:

- We will produce a brief change order (1–2 pages) referencing Section 2 (Order Form commitments) and Exhibit B (Implementation SOW) of the MSA. Proposed language: "Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Customer may reassign up to 30% of committed units to an alternate region via a mutually executed Change Order. Fees shall be prorated for the remainder of the quarter based on assigned region pricing at the time of reallocation."
- Need confirmation whether region SKU pricing parity is contractual (Elaine — you said you prefer neutral effect). If NovaApps expects full price parity, please confirm. If parity is not guaranteed, we'll include an explicit fee reconciliation step.
- Implementation SOW edit: propose an Exhibit B paragraph (new subsection) with: cutover window, rollback criteria, testing acceptance steps, and owner contacts. I will draft the paragraph but need a 1-paragraph rollback criteria from NovaApps (e.g., <30% error rate on inference ops for 2 consecutive hours OR ability to switch traffic back within 30 minutes).
- For billing/proration calculations: finance needs the exact start timestamp for the eu assignment and whether the change should take effect at the start of the next billing cycle or immediately (pro-rate to the timestamp). Laura — can you confirm Redwood's preferred operational approach? We typically pro-rate to timestamp and bill on next invoice cycle, but we can align to customer preference.

Attaching my initial redline (redline_v1.docx) — it contains the proposed one-paragraph amendment and an Exhibit B snippet. This is a working draft; please review and flag any provisioning/security caveats (if any).

I'll aim to get a DocuSign-ready PDF by Oct 20 EOD if NovaApps confirms the parity and rollback bullets by EOD Oct 19.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_v1.docx (change order draft)
From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@novaapps.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Green <matthew.green@novaapps.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T18:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: redistribute committed capacity and SOW edit

Thanks Rishi and team — draft looks reasonable overall. Quick answers:
- NovaApps confirms we expect pricing parity for region SKUs for this reassignment (we will not accept a price uplift). Please include explicit language stating no automatic cross-region uplift for this specific reassignment.
- Rollback acceptance criteria (one-paragraph, for your SOW snippet): "Rollback will be initiated if production inference error rate increases by >5 percentage points above baseline sustained for 1 hour, or if average 95th latency increases by >200ms for 30 minutes. NovaApps and Redwood will coordinate a controlled rollback pathway within 30 minutes of trigger detection."
- Effective timestamp: please pro-rate to the timestamp when the change order is executed (DocuSign completion) and apply to the current billing cycle. That simplifies our internal accounting.

We have a 30-minute slot tomorrow Oct 21 at 10:00am PT to walk the redline if that helps. Otherwise EOD Oct 20 DocuSign-ready would be ideal as requested — if you need to slip, let us know by 9pm PT tonight.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Elaine Turner
Procurement Manager | NovaApps
